What guests come for

From what guests write on Google and what Bol says on Instagram.

Smoothies with fresh ingredients

Green Mojito, Tropical and more. One guest writes it was the only smoothie place they found with really fresh ingredients.

Protein and fresh juices

Protein smoothies, protein powder in your smoothie and fresh juices.

Specialty coffee

Guests call it high quality coffee, and there is matcha too.

Healthy snacks

Overnight oats with protein, vegan sandwiches, wraps, yoghurt from the fridge and tahini cookies.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Seats outside

A quiet, shady seating area outside, kept clean, as guests write.

Quick breakfast

Open from 7 on weekdays. Guests stop for coffee and a snack from the fridge before shopping.

Delivery

Smoothies and juices can also be ordered through Foody, as one guest writes.

At the municipal market

Bol is at the municipal market in the Paphos old town. Mint walls, white globe lamps, a fridge full of fresh snacks and a shelf with coffee beans; outside, grey tables under sunshades. On Instagram Bol describes itself as locally made, healthy, vegan friendly and pet friendly.
